en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks taught the Dhamma to those traveling in vehicles...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I shall not teach the Dhamma to one who is not ill and is traveling in a vehicle.
A cart, a chariot, a wagon, a carriage, a palanquin, or a litter.
The Dhamma should not be taught to one who is not ill and is traveling in a vehicle.
Whoever, out of disrespect, teaches the Dhamma to one who is not ill and is traveling in a vehicle, commits an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
[and so on] ... for the first offender.
The third training rule is concluded.
